NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Case No.: EXT-2020-01 Location: 900 W. Foothill Blvd., Azusa, CA
APN: 8616-002-006
Applicant: Rick Martinez
The City of Azusa received a request for an Extension of Time request for a previously approved project – DR-2019-17 (Design Review to construct a new 138,454 sq.ft. self-storage building), MUP-2019-12 (Minor Use Permit for self-storage use), and MV-2019-02 (Minor Variance for reduction in parking spaces).
This project is still categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 32 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15332), (California Environmental Quality Act).
